name: Manitou Springs
seo_title: Manitou Springs Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Manitou Springs, CO: the Christmas Parade, Breakfast with Santa, Victorian Christmas at Miramont Castle, the Elf on the Shelf Hunt and more.
lede: Manitou Springs keeps Christmas on Manitou Avenue, with a nighttime parade on December 6, a Kiwanis Breakfast with Santa, a downtown elf hunt and Santa at the Wheeler Town Clock on Christmas Eve, plus a North Pole workshop up the Ute Pass in Cascade.
celebrates: Manitou Springs, at the foot of Pikes Peak, centers its holiday season on downtown Manitou Avenue. Visit Manitou Springs, the town's chamber and visitors bureau, lists the Christmas Parade, Breakfast with Santa, Strolling Holiday Brass, the Elf on the Shelf Hunt and Santa at the Wheeler Town Clock on its holiday traditions page. Miramont Castle Museum adds a Victorian Christmas weekend, and Cascade, a few miles up the Ute Pass, has a North Pole themed Santa's workshop. Families can shop and eat downtown before or after any of the events.
lastyear: Last year's holiday calendar was already built around Manitou Avenue. The chamber's holiday page describes the parade as a nighttime tradition with glowing floats, carolers and Santa, and asks families to bring a new, unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots. The Elf on the Shelf Hunt is now in its fourth year, and Santa has gathered letters at the Wheeler Town Clock each season for children to mail in before December 18.
facts: The Elf on the Shelf Hunt hides three elves in three new shops or restaurants each week for four weeks, and the chamber awards $25 in Manitou Money to a weekly winner. Visit Manitou Springs keeps a Visitors Center at 354 Manitou Avenue, where blank letters to Santa are available. The Kiwanis Club serves Breakfast with Santa in Memorial Hall at Manitou Springs City Hall, 606 Manitou Avenue. Miramont Castle Museum is at 9 Capitol Hill Avenue.
trains: Manitou Springs is the home station of the Pikes Peak Cog Railway, which climbs from the foot of Pikes Peak. We have not found a Christmas train event on the railway's own site for 2026, so check the railway's page on our museum guide for current operating details before you plan a ride. Families who want a train day out can also look at our Cripple Creek and Victor Narrow Gauge Railroad guide, a drive up Highway 24 and over to Cripple Creek.

kidfact: Kids can mail a letter to Santa at the Wheeler Town Clock by December 18, and Santa comes back to that same clock on Christmas Eve.
faq: Where can kids see Santa in Manitou Springs?

The Manitou Springs Kiwanis Club hosts Breakfast with Santa on December 5 at City Hall, and the chamber lists Santa at the Wheeler Town Clock on Christmas Eve, December 24, at 6 pm. Santa also rides in the Christmas Parade on December 6. Check each listing on this page for current details.
Is the Manitou Springs Christmas Parade free?

Yes. Visit Manitou Springs describes the parade as a free nighttime parade down Manitou Avenue on December 6 at 6 pm. The chamber asks families to bring a new, unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots if they can.
What free things can kids do in downtown Manitou Springs?
The Elf on the Shelf Hunt runs through noon on December 20, and Strolling Holiday Brass plays free carols on several Sundays and on Christmas Eve. The Christmas Parade is free to watch as well.
Can I ride the Pikes Peak Cog Railway at Christmas?
The railway departs from Manitou Springs. We have not found a 2026 Christmas train event on its own site, so check the railway's page and our museum guide for current operating details before you go.
Is there anything for kids near Manitou Springs?
Cascade, a few miles up Ute Pass, has a North Pole themed Santa's workshop, and our Colorado Springs guide covers larger events such as lights, markets and shows.
